notes:
• Merge Exhibits (⌥⌘M, ribbon Merge, context menu): the kept exhibit retains number, title and file; the others become its attachments and bring their notes, tags, people, references, collections and timeline entries along — optionally with their PDF pages combined into one document. Exhibit ▸ Undo Last Merge puts everything back.
• Guards: locked exhibits, notes and attachments are refused; a warning when an absorbed exhibit is numbered or included in the submission. "Merge Selected…" in the Duplicates window.
• Fix: Edit Pages no longer fails with "Couldn’t replace the managed copy" when exhibit files live on another volume.
